notes.title: Major FREE Update ‘Shrimplosion’ update is OUT!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a while since our last post, because we’ve been busy cooking something special for you![/p][p]We’re so excited to share our brand-new [b]free Update ‘Shrimplosion[/b]’- this one’s for those of you who love tiny pet chaos (and that [url="https://youtu.be/YOwUIn1E0S4?feature=shared"][u]space shrimp video[/u][/url])![/p][p][/p][p]You can see the famous Shrimp band in action in the trailer below:[/p][previewyoutube="nPnQTyrqoFo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s swimming your way:[/p][list][*][p]🦐 [b]The Shrimplosion is in town[/b]! A legendary music band of 4 shrimps can now be obtained, and will even start playing their hit song once they’re placed in your aquarium. [/p][/*][*][p][b]💰 New shop tab,[/b] with a wide array of items (including mutators 👀) and exclusive decorations![/p][/*][*][p]🐚 [b]Fishing cosmetics shop, [/b]where you can buy cool new ship skins and effects using shells![/p][/*][*][p]🐠 [b]15 new fish and shellfish species[/b], including the sea bunny 🐰
(Full list: Blue Crayfish, Amano Shrimp, Babaulti Shrimp, Blue Velvet Shrimp, Crystal Red Shrimp, Ghost Shrimp, Mantis Shrimp, Common Jellyfish, Flying Fish, Sea Bunny, Magical Magmafish, and The Shrimplosion band!).[/p][/*][*][p]🎁 [b]15 new tank decorations
(Full list: [/b]Golden Chest, Blue Crystal, Pink Crystal, Runic Stone, Rock Cave, Clay Pot, Moss Balls, Stacked Stones, and 5 New Seaweed and wood Types).[/p][/*][*][p]🧼 Introducing the Instaclean: a new tank tool that’ll clean your aquarium in one swipe[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎉 +1 new aquarium tank[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]📍 [b]New quests[/b], and a bigger quest pool! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ve also had a lot of requests for it, so we’re bringing back the time-limited Axolotl Event! If you didn’t get one before, now is your chance to make your tank that much cuter! ♥️[/p][p]As always, we would like to extend a huge [b]thank you[/b] to our amazing community. Your creations and feedback are always a source of inspiration for our updates 🙂. We can’t wait to see how you customise your tanks, now with tiny concerts!

[/p][p]Best fishes!
- Can & Egon from the Lunheim Team 🐙[/p]

notes.title: A “Thank YOU!” content update 🙂 New fish, new decorations
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,
[/p][p]What a wild week it’s been!
[/p][p]Since launching on Monday, we’ve already sold over 25,000 copies, and our little aquarium game now has more than 400 reviews with a [i]“Very Positive”[/i] rating on Steam 🥰
[/p][p]Your warm reception has been truly humbling. We honestly never expected so many of you would play our cozy little game - in fact, things got [i]so[/i] unexpectedly busy that our servers crashed, and Egon had to pull an all-nighter to fix them!
To make up for it, we’ll be[b] extending the Axolotl event for an extra week[/b] so nobody misses out because of the hiccups.
[/p][p]We’ve loved meeting some of you in the fishing lobbies and visiting your aquariums, and we thought the best way to say THANK YOU is with a[b] little extra content drop[/b]! 🙂[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/97870eebc3db465d08897050b03b6fb8d565a9f6.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/4c7545fbbb78d187f5e5adee05ba396e1593f108.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/44a9e7ab94acbbe2fef2dd4331365eca7f700cc1.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/bed3d025ce2d6b454d7ed61e8a089a2804e8c696.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/73c8fa8c2167a509fb3b67254251635f2ba1602d.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]With this very first content update, you’ll find [b]new fish [/b]and [b]new decorations[/b] to unlock:[/p][list][*][p]🦈 Sturgeon fish[/p][/*][*][p]🐟 Bluegill fish[/p][/*][*][p]🏮 Lantern[/p][/*][*][p]🌺 Sea anemone[/p][/*][*][p]🗡️ Aquacalibur!  [/p][/*][/list][p][i]All of this new content is exclusive to fishing![/i][/p][p][/p][p]We’re also working hard behind the scenes, pushing patches and fixes every day. Thank you so much for your patience!  We’re committed to ironing out the remaining issues as quickly as possible!
[/p][p]If you haven’t left a review yet, we’d really appreciate it - reviews make a big difference in helping Tiny Aquarium reach more players ❤️ [/p][p]Best fishes, and see you soon with more Tiny Aquarium content!
 - Can & Egon from the Lunheim Team 🐙[/p]
